Simplified Chinese, crisp natural-size controls, flat white/#f7f8fa, dark #272b3a/secondary#657084, thin #e6e9f1 lines, primary#4566c6,8px radii and restrained shadow. PILOT input is STYLE ONLY, no importing its rail/header/tree/content. Actual source templates determine all titles, field order, controls, permissions and selected state. No protocol requestId/version/hash/cursor/CSRF fields, fabricated success/online states, team/AI/ToDoo features or OS/browser-dialog chrome. Secret data empty or masked only. One coherent selected condition; hidden alternatives remain hidden. Preserve header/close/body-scroll/footer actions and actual disabled guards; do not derive new disabled rules from API constraints.
UNFINISHED PRIMARY DIAGRAM CREATION RECOVERY in the REAL 新建白板 MODAL. Image1 actual empty new-whiteboard baseline is form/host reference; pending-intent block is explicitly SOURCE-DERIVED. Draw entire existing modal only, not full owner workspace. Actual template always renders source location/name fields even though generic sourceContracts.fields is empty; preserve them.
Title 新建白板 and enabled closeX. Fields exact order 所在目录 closed tree-select00-Inbox, 文件名 EMPTY text input focused with source placeholder 例如：新的想法.md. Existing help 源与 PNG 预览完整保存后创建 Markdown 图形文档，默认私有。 Then actual pending-state status block 未完成的图形：00-Inbox/未完成白板.md (synthetic relative path, read-only), with two real controls 恢复未完成图形 and 取消未完成图形.
